en.title: Read AI research papers
en.description: Retrieve paper text and structured metadata from Hugging Face paper pages.
tasks: Retrieve paper text and structured metadata from Hugging Face paper pages.
prerequisites: Network access to Hugging Face; authentication only for write endpoints.
en.example: Use huggingface-papers. Summarize this paper’s method, evaluation, limitations, and links to released models.
en.expectedResult: A source-linked summary separating paper claims from interpretation.
limitations: Missing paper text or artifacts must remain explicit gaps rather than inferred results.

zh.title: 阅读 AI 研究论文
zh.description: 从 Hugging Face 论文页获取正文与结构化元数据。
tasks: 从 Hugging Face 论文页获取正文与结构化元数据。
prerequisites: 可访问 Hugging Face 的网络；写入接口才需要登录。
zh.example: 请使用 huggingface-papers：概括此论文的方法、评估、限制及已发布模型链接。
zh.expectedResult: 带来源链接、区分论文声明与解读的摘要。
limitations: 缺失正文或附件应明确标注，不推测实验结果。
